title: Finite leaf bootstrap above PR182: conditional kappa = 0.000660627334074291
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Replace the legacy ordinary routine at stopped bit leaves with PR182's already completed ordinary supplier, then apply three fixed acyclic wrapper levels. This gives conditional

`kappa = 660627334074291/10^18 = 0.000660627334074291`,

**0.062219% above PR182's 0.000660216552061722** at `af90b94783f7d104a0be75c762ade758bec75855`.

The physical complex/bit words, matching, terminal sinks, frames, prime witnesses and histograms are unchanged. For coarse saving `c = 0.000661064051056`, atom exponent `theta = c`, and immutable PR182 ordinary saving `a_0`, each level has `a_(j+1) = (1-c)c + c a_j`. The finite three-level chain pays strict adapter and internal-borrowing tolls and feeds the retained paid balanced 47-constraint assembly. It never calls itself at the same level or claims to attain the infinite-depth limit.

The compositional proof checks weighted leaves, arbitrary complete spectators, nested borrowed-row restoration, radix padding, fixed tape constants and all-size uniformity. Existing hypotheses remain conditional; finite arithmetic and replay do not prove those interfaces. The retained 252 external reserve is conservative slack, not a bound on new internal borrowing.

This is a modest improvement. PR183's ceiling observation concerns fixed suppliers; this change increases the ordinary supplier through finite composition. The package preserves all prerequisite files.

## Validation

- Exact paid supplier moments, three finite bootstrap levels, 47 strict inequalities and seven margins pass; adjacent bit/final grid points are rejected.
- Adversarial controls reject fictional leaves, invalid bootstrap depth, unpaid atom tolls, row/scalar omissions and overstated suppliers.
- Independent composition review and rational recurrence agree. Independent prime-power weighted-leaf algebra covers 178 unit cases and rejects six mutations.
- Fresh underlying PR182 complete complex and bit word replay passed, including full formal columns, signed/defining-integer checks, frames, prime witnesses and 21 inherited assembly controls. The package validation receipt records the log hash.
- Full verification passed on research head `32daefe471e1e41926971747bb901e2839938b43`: all 14 native Makefile groups on Python 3.11/3.13/3.14, all three formal packages, and the selected gate, for 46 successful jobs. Native jobs also passed `git diff --exit-code`. [Native/formal run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37925267279) and [selected/physical replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37925267558). Downloaded log archives were independently hash- and integrity-checked. The follow-up commit changes only this package's validation receipt, README status and corresponding README source hash; mathematical sources are unchanged.

Run `python3 -B research/bit-leaf-bootstrap182/verify.py`.
